title: Expired shares continue to disclose documents

trace.description: Authenticated caller selects document ID in GET /documents/{doc_id}.
Original can_read omitted the required condition; cited current location contains its fix.
Return the full copied document as JSON.

evidence.description: Four failing denial assertions observed HTTP 200 rather than 404.
All ten tests passed after the focused patch; Python exit code 0.

counterevidence: Share creation rejects past deadlines and read checks revoked. Neither re-evaluates a previously valid deadline at read time. The expiry and exact-deadline tests both returned 200 before the fix.

likelihood.reason: Requires prior legitimate access followed by expiry or trusted migration.

impact.reason: Read disclosure of previously accessible documents beyond authorization lifetime; no new grant, write, or broad arbitrary-document access demonstrated.

conditions.description: A recipient has a previously valid, unrevoked share whose deadline has passed.

ext.description: Bob requests document a after an owner-created share expires. The original read predicate checked recipient and revocation but ignored expires_at; the GET still returned 200 with the document.
ext.fix: Require time() < expires_at for each matching, unrevoked share; equality denies access.

title: Former tenant members retain document access

trace.description: Authenticated caller selects document ID in GET /documents/{doc_id}.
Original can_read omitted the required condition; cited current location contains its fix.
Return the full copied document as JSON.

evidence.description: Four failing denial assertions observed HTTP 200 rather than 404.
All ten tests passed after the focused patch; Python exit code 0.

counterevidence: Sharing and revocation check owner and current tenant; those guards do not execute on GET. Ownership and a live share cannot substitute for the separate current membership requirement. Both migration tests failed before the fix.

likelihood.reason: Requires prior legitimate access followed by expiry or trusted migration.

impact.reason: Read disclosure of previously accessible documents beyond authorization lifetime; no new grant, write, or broad arbitrary-document access demonstrated.

conditions.description: The trusted directory moves a document owner or an existing share recipient to another tenant. The caller remains authenticated.

ext.description: After trusted directory migration from north to south, Bob can still read north document a through a live share; migrated owner Alice can also still read a. Both GETs returned 200. Current tenant membership was absent from can_read.
ext.fix: Deny tenant mismatch before either ownership or share authorization.
